11.t: Working with data: oxygen and exercise
q: Read the oxygen used at 8 km/h.
Calculate how many times more oxygen is used at 12 km/h than at rest.
Name three organ systems that work together to get this oxygen to the muscles.
Breathing (respiratory) system, circulatory system (heart, blood), and the muscles/ cells that use it in respiration.
Explain why the curve levels off at high speed, and what the muscles do then.
Heart and lungs reach their maximum rate of delivering oxygen. Muscles then also respire anaerobically, making lactic acid.
